Nexirya — Full rules

  1. Respect everyone. No insults, harassment, discrimination or hate speech.
  2. No spam. No flooding, excessive caps or mass mentions.
  3. No ads or self-promotion. No invite links or promotions without staff approval.
  4. Stay on topic. Use each channel for its purpose.
  5. Appropriate names and avatars. Nothing offensive or impersonating others.
  6. No NSFW or disturbing content. Keep it friendly for everyone.
  7. Voice chat etiquette. No screaming, loud noises or soundboard abuse. Mute if you have background noise.
  8. Play fair. No cheating, trolling or ruining games of Domino, Spy or Among Us. Don’t leak roles.
  9. Protect privacy. Don’t share personal information or private chats without consent.
  10. Follow Discord’s rules. Discord’s Terms of Service and Community Guidelines apply here.
  11. Listen to the staff. If you disagree with a decision, talk to a moderator privately.
  12. Report problems. Tell a moderator instead of handling it yourself.

Breaking the rules may lead to a warning, mute, kick or ban depending on severity.
